story: Meena Aunty chettinchukunna Chinni bidda arughyam kosthe kothili gadda kattinchukundhi, chinni bidda kasta kuda kasthundhi.
script:
Meena aunty: "Oka kothili gadda petki vachi..". Chinni bidda: "Aa oka gadda, appudekkada!"
Meena aunty: "Chinni, oka gadda chesi, kasta vacheyyadi leka?"
Chinni bidda: "Aa.."
[Sound: A 'kaat' sound effect when Chinni cuts the string]
Meena aunty: "Bidda, kasta lekunda?"
Chinni: "Appudekkada, kasta vachi, amma!"]
video_prompt: Create a short, 10-second animation of an overzealous Meena Aunty (Indian mother figure) trying to pull out a small thread that's stuck in her grandson Chinni's tummy. Chinni initially resists, but Meena Aunty persists, then finally Chinni succumbs and pulls out the thread. The animation should be colorful and fast-paced.
title: చన్నీ బిడ్డలో కట్టుకోచే గడ్డం!
